name: request_review
description:
Request an independent review of a completed plan step's change set. Spawns a review subagent that inspects the step's commits/files and returns a structured verdict — "approve" or "request_changes" with inline findings. Call this right after you mark a step done. Then do exactly what the tool result's next action says — it encodes the current review policy: it may tell you to fix the findings and request_review again, or to stop and report them to the user. The reviewer is read-only; it never edits your files.

After you mark a plan step done, call request_review with that step's id: an independent review subagent inspects its change set and returns a verdict. Then follow the next action stated in the tool result verbatim — it encodes the configured review policy. When it says to fix, do so immediately and autonomously (set the step back to in_progress, apply every fix, mark done, re-review) — never ask the user for permission or report findings when the result tells you to fix. When it says to stop and report, do that instead. This is how plan steps get reviewed — the user does not trigger review manually.

itemId.description: The plan item id (todo id) whose completed change set should be reviewed.
